name: to-falando
description: ToFalany: app privado de texto, voz, vídeo e transmissão de tela para um grupo de amigos.

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run test:e2e -w client
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w shared && npm run dev -w server
scripts.dev:client: npm run build -w shared && npm run dev -w client
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build -w shared && npm run dist:linux -w client
scripts.dist:win: npm run build -w shared && npm run dist:win -w client
